title: Document Template
description: AIP schema for skills that specify a document rather than a procedure: where the document lives, what sections it carries, the rules its content obeys, and whether it is a historical record whose words may not later change. The output is the subject; any steps involved in producing it are incidental.

name.description: The section heading as it appears in the document.

guidance.description: What belongs in the section, and what does not.

mandatory.description: Optional. False for a section that is kept only when it applies. Defaults to true - a section that is usually dropped is usually not a section.

records_gate.description: Optional. The gate whose approval this section records. A gate that did not apply is recorded as N/A with its reason rather than being deleted.

purpose.description: What the document is for as a coherent unit of work - what it captures and what it adds beyond general agent knowledge. One short paragraph.

trigger_when.description: Conditions under which the agent should consider this skill. Mixed granularity expected.

do_not_use_when.description: Optional. Conditions under which a different document, or none, is the right answer.

realizes_process.description: Optional. IDs of the level-2 processes this document belongs to, from the method's process model. Omit when the document is an output specification that no process is accountable for on its own.

output.description: Where the document lands, and how a reader finds it.

location.description: Path or path pattern for the document, relative to the project root.

naming.description: Optional. The filename convention, including how the number is allocated where documents are numbered.

index.description: Optional. The index the document is added to in the same change. A document nothing indexes is a document nobody finds.

sections.description: The document's sections, in the order they appear.

template_asset.description: Optional. Relative path under assets/ to the fill-in template. Where present it is the source of truth for the document's literal shape, and the sections list is its index.

immutability.description: Optional. Whether the document is a historical record once merged, and what may still be changed afterwards. Link targets get repaired when files move; the words do not change.

rules.description: Optional. Rules the content obeys, beyond the shape the sections give it.

scenarios.description: Optional. Worked examples of the document applied to concrete cases. Documentation, not a runtime decision table.

need.description: The situation calling for the document.

anti_patterns.description: Optional. Concrete corrections to mistakes the agent would otherwise make when writing this document.
